text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racetrack erupted over Hokko Tarumae's 
victory! She was now just one step away 
from achieving the historic milestone of 
"Most GⅠ Wins in History"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her running, she showed Copano 
Rickey that this is the front lines of 
dirt racing. It was the very thing she had 
learned from Wonder Acute last year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them, Wonder Acute 
muttered with deep emotion: that this is 
how feelings are passed down through 
generations—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Smart Falcon announces her 
surprise entry into the Tokyo Daishoten in 
an emergency livestream! Her wish 
fulfilled, Hokko Tarumae is deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chance to repay Smart Falcon directly 
had finally arrived! The Tokyo Daishoten 
was right around the corner...!
